unit_tests.followup_check: Strengthened relation strict species/parent fold candidate-export assertions passed separately.

scope: negative mining and exposure count consistency
findings: Query/reference coordinate projection is row-local and shared; references detach before projection while projection parameters retain gradients.
Local matching weights combine both directions; exact nearest ties receive equal weights; each direction normalizes over its own token count.
Raw pair graph is batch-local and reused explicitly; forward validates query dictionary identity and bank object identity before reuse.
Both parent/fine raw pairs are masked with bank.permitted result before aggregation, BCE, and negative selection; removed leaves/self hashes cannot become top-k witnesses or mined negatives.
Negative mining operates per query and reference leaf using detached raw verifier logits, selects only permissions-approved negatives, and leaves all positive pairs intact.
Equal-leaf and equal-group BCE weighting is preserved; exposure audits call the identical selector with the same head-specific scores.
No identified Long matrix multiplication introduced in relation or mining paths; existing CUDA count fix remains elementwise integer multiply-and-sum.
limitations: No CUDA device available to execute GPU paths.
Cache object-identity check intentionally relies on documented caller contract against in-place encoded/bank mutation or cross-optimizer reuse; pipeline respects the contract.

contracts: One query backbone pass and one pair graph shared across support interventions.
Pair symmetry, exact nearest-match ties, token/reference permutation, and chunked gradient equivalence.
Directional coordinate features distinguish constructed pairs with equal original scalar evidence.
Self-content and episode exclusions before pooling, pair loss, and hard-negative selection.
TRAIN cache detached; query/local/projection/head gradients retained.
Hard negatives selected per reference leaf; all allowed positives and balanced groups retained.
Negative exposure audits reuse the loss selector and count only selected effective negative pairs.
Empty support permissions have finite backward and zero forbidden contribution.
Known-only candidate checkpoint selection matches deployment identity rule without thresholds.
Diagnostics detached and absent from loss weighting or model selection.
Synthetic CPU train/calibrate/test with content deduplication, immutable stage signatures and artifact hashes.
Synthetic strict TRAIN-only species and parent fold retraining; raw candidate export, no membership thresholds applied.
